findings.highlight: do anything she wishes, like a Servant under a Command Spell
findings.evidenceJa: マスターらしく、令呪でイリヤの望みに応える
findings.governingReading: answer Illya’s wish through the conceit of a Command Spell, in a manner befitting a Master
findings.explanation: The setup frames Shirou immediately as the compelled Servant and broadens one response into “anything” before he has proposed the one-command arrangement.

findings.highlight: Thenwhy don’t I
findings.evidenceJa: ならマスターらしく
findings.governingReading: Then why don’t I
findings.explanation: A missing word boundary visibly fuses “Then” and “why.”

findings.highlight: I swear on my Crest
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の刻印に誓って
findings.governingReading: swearing upon his own mark
findings.explanation: “Crest” invokes the setting’s inherited Magic Crest terminology even though the source only says his own mark in the Command Spell conceit.

findings.highlight: I swear while looking Illya in the eyes.
findings.evidenceJa: 背をかがめて、まっすぐにイリヤを見て誓う
findings.governingReading: he bends down and swears while looking directly at Illya
findings.explanation: Shirou lowering himself to Illya’s height disappears from the physical staging.

findings.highlight: gasps
findings.evidenceJa: 静かに息を呑んで
findings.governingReading: quietly catches or holds her breath
findings.explanation: Illya’s quiet arrested breath becomes an overt gasp, repeating the prior branch’s reversal.

findings.highlight: a big smile
findings.evidenceJa: 心からの笑顔
findings.governingReading: a heartfelt smile
findings.explanation: The sincerity with which Shirou receives Illya’s anxious look becomes mere visual size.

findings.highlight: Then, I want……
findings.evidenceJa: ……に、連れていって
findings.governingReading: then… take me to…
findings.explanation: The deliberately incomplete request still contains the concrete “take me” frame in Japanese; mirror moon removes that clue entirely.

findings.highlight: It’s something I’d easily be able to do
findings.evidenceJa: 言ってくれれば幾らでも付き合ってやれる事
findings.governingReading: something he would accompany her in as often or as much as she wished, if only she asked
findings.explanation: The availability of Shirou’s companionship is reduced to ease of performance.

findings.highlight: I’ve always wanted to do something like that.
findings.evidenceJa: ずっとそういうのに憧れてた
findings.governingReading: she has long yearned for that kind of experience
findings.explanation: Illya’s sustained aspiration is flattened into a generic desire to perform an activity.

findings.highlight: what I want from you right now
findings.evidenceJa: 一番シロウにしてほしいコト
findings.governingReading: the thing she most wants Shirou to do for her
findings.explanation: The superlative emotional priority becomes temporary present preference.

findings.highlight: There’s no way I can question her now.
findings.evidenceJa: そのありったけの勇気に
findings.governingReading: in the face of all the courage Illya has mustered
findings.explanation: The courage required for Illya to voice the request disappears.

findings.highlight: it’s her wish
findings.evidenceJa: それはイリヤの一番の願いだった
findings.governingReading: it is Illya’s greatest wish
findings.explanation: The repeated superlative defining the request’s importance is removed.

findings.highlight: I have to protect her as her knight.
findings.evidenceJa: 精一杯彼女を守らないといけない
findings.governingReading: as her knight, he must protect her with everything he has
findings.explanation: The full extent of Shirou’s voluntary knightly commitment disappears.

findings.highlight: ThenI have to protect her
findings.evidenceJa: なら俺はイリヤの騎士として
findings.governingReading: Then I have to protect her
findings.explanation: A missing word boundary visibly fuses “Then” and “I.”

findings.highlight: She asked for an everyday event.
findings.evidenceJa: 望めば幾らでも叶う
findings.governingReading: something that could be fulfilled whenever and as often as she wished
findings.explanation: The painful availability of what Illya lacks disappears.

findings.highlight: She asked for an everyday event.
findings.evidenceJa: ただの日常をこそイリヤは望んだ
findings.governingReading: what Illya desired above all was ordinary everyday life itself
findings.explanation: A defining statement about Illya’s desire for ordinary life is reduced to requesting one commonplace outing.

findings.highlight: not like Masters
findings.evidenceJa: 敵も味方もなく
findings.governingReading: with neither enemies nor allies
findings.explanation: The temporary suspension of enemy and ally categories disappears.

findings.highlight: the familiar scenery
findings.evidenceJa: 見慣れた店、見飽きた景色
findings.governingReading: shops familiar to Shirou and scenery he has seen to the point of boredom
findings.explanation: The contrast between Shirou’s exhausted familiarity and Illya’s shining novelty is generalized.

findings.highlight: because she’s sadand because
findings.evidenceJa: 少女は悲しいからユメから覚めたくないから
findings.governingReading: because she’s sad and because
findings.explanation: A missing boundary visibly fuses “sad” and “and.”

findings.highlight: I finally realize
findings.evidenceJa: 気付いてしまった
findings.governingReading: he realizes despite himself
findings.explanation: The painful, unwanted nature of Shirou’s realization becomes a neutral delayed discovery.

findings.highlight: The end comes
findings.evidenceJa: 終わりは当然のようにやってくる
findings.governingReading: the ending arrives as naturally and inevitably as though it were only to be expected
findings.explanation: The scene’s sense of inevitable closure is reduced to the bare occurrence of an ending.

findings.highlight: The only item she asked me to buy her was her drink.
findings.evidenceJa: コートのポケットに仕舞われたままだ
findings.governingReading: Illya’s sole requested purchase remains put away in her coat pocket
findings.explanation: mirror moon omits that she never opens or drinks the oshiruko, removing a concrete sign that the purchase itself was symbolic.

findings.highlight: I’ll lift the Command Spell here.
findings.evidenceJa: 令呪はここでおしまいにするね
findings.governingReading: she declares the notional Command Spell finished here
findings.explanation: “Lift” implies removing an operative magical effect, although no actual Command Spell or binding exists.

findings.highlight: Smiling resolutely
findings.evidenceJa: 何の未練もない笑顔
findings.governingReading: a smile showing no lingering attachment
findings.explanation: Illya’s displayed absence of regret or attachment becomes generic determination.

findings.highlight: Shinto
findings.evidenceJa: 新都
findings.governingReading: the New City district
findings.explanation: mirror moon again renders the place-name category as the unrelated word “Shinto.”

findings.highlight: That place is far better than
findings.evidenceJa: あそこならここよりもっと
findings.governingReading: over there they could do much more than here
findings.explanation: The interrupted promise of greater scope becomes a judgment that New City is intrinsically better.

findings.highlight: Our relationship was set in stone before we met.
findings.evidenceJa: 出会う前からちゃんと分かっていた
findings.governingReading: she understood all of this clearly before they met
findings.explanation: Illya’s prior understanding is inflated into deterministic immutability.

findings.highlight: she casts away her wishes
findings.evidenceJa: その幻想を切り捨てる
findings.governingReading: she cuts away that illusion
findings.explanation: The specifically illusory ordinary life is generalized into Illya discarding all her wishes.

findings.highlight: this place without destination or backtrack
findings.evidenceJa: 行き先もなく、後戻りも出来ない場所
findings.governingReading: a place with nowhere onward to go and no possibility of turning back
findings.explanation: The terminal metaphor is rendered in conspicuously non-English phrasing.

findings.highlight: A distant scenery is in front of me
findings.evidenceJa: そこには遠い景色があった
findings.governingReading: a distant, otherworldly scene lies before him
findings.explanation: The mass noun “scenery” is incorrectly given an indefinite article, and the estranging image becomes a location statement.

findings.highlight: It’s not because of the snow, but because of the dancing girl.
findings.evidenceJa: 目の前でステップを踏むイリヤの姿が、有りえないものに見えて
findings.governingReading: the sight of Illya stepping before him appears impossible
findings.explanation: The sentence loses the predicate that Illya’s figure seems impossible, leaving only a contrastive fragment.

findings.highlight: It looks like it’ll stop soon.
findings.evidenceJa: 粉雪は弱々しく
findings.governingReading: the powdery snow falls weakly
findings.explanation: The snow’s fine texture and frailty disappear, leaving only the prediction that it will stop.

findings.highlight: Illya is completely surrounded in white snow
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの周りだけがあんなにも白い
findings.governingReading: only the space around Illya is so extraordinarily white
findings.explanation: The exclusive, apparition-like whiteness around Illya becomes ordinary physical enclosure by snow.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what’s so fun
findings.evidenceJa: それが何より嬉しいのか
findings.governingReading: as though ordinary snow delights her more than anything
findings.explanation: Shirou’s perception of exceptional delight is reversed into failure to understand why she is enjoying herself.

findings.highlight: I was praised that my hair is white and feminine.
findings.evidenceJa: 白くて女の子らしいって誉めてくれた
findings.governingReading: someone praised her hair for being white and girlish
findings.explanation: The remembered compliment is expressed through an ungrammatical “praised that” construction.

findings.highlight: By watching her, I can tell who praised her.
findings.evidenceJa: 理由もなく、判ってしまった
findings.governingReading: without any reason, Shirou simply understands who said it
findings.explanation: An explicitly reasonless intuition is assigned a visual evidentiary cause.

findings.highlight: These things I already know.
findings.evidenceJa: そんなもの、本当はとっくに気がついている
findings.governingReading: in truth, he realized those reasons long ago
findings.explanation: The same duration-bearing realization from the prior branch is again weakened to present knowledge.

findings.highlight: I, an unrelated child, pursued him as his son.
findings.evidenceJa: その背中を追い続けた無縁の子供
findings.governingReading: the unrelated child who kept following Kiritsugu’s back as his son
findings.explanation: The sustained image of following Kiritsugu’s back and path becomes the more aggressive and ambiguous “pursued him.”

findings.highlight: leaves the park
findings.evidenceJa: 公園から消えていった
findings.governingReading: disappears from the park
findings.explanation: The visual disappearance concluding Illya’s farewell is flattened into ordinary departure.

findings.highlight: As though her presence was what sustained it
findings.evidenceJa: 冬の象徴が去り
findings.governingReading: the symbol of winter departs
findings.explanation: Illya’s identification as winter’s emblem is omitted and replaced by an inferred causal claim about her sustaining the snow.
